One Lighthouse LH01-0084 評価と操作と写真をまとめる施設概要. Input1 ORIGINAL overview controls photo/artwork/crops, rating, wheelchair, all geometry. Input2 supporting ORIGINAL actionbar controls reused action glyphs. Input3 Japanese mock supplies authored Japanese example copy/layout; its paperplane/straightarrow/newspaper action glyphs and five-green-stars are WRONG.
Purewhite#FFFFFF panel. Header "代々木の公園" Meiryo Bold70020/28; source rating "4.7" then FOUR solid GOLD fullstars and FIFTH EXACT LEFT-HALF gold/right-halfgray star, then "（14,868件）". Do not invent70percent/star orfivefull. Metadata Regular40012/16, tracking0. Next native category "公園・車いす対応" with ORIGINAL wheelchair accessibility symbol preserved in slate#526173 (human head, seat, bentleg and large wheel); do not substitute genericperson. Status "営業中・22:00に終了", Regular14/24, first営業中green, restmuted; static example snapshot.
Actionrow uses EXACT input2: primary forestgreen-gradient circular directions action with WHITE DIAMOND containing BENT RIGHT-TURN arrow; secondary white outlined pills: source outline bookmark +"保存"; source SHARE TRAY with UPWARD arrow +"共有"; source GLOBE with geographic landshapes +"公式". Utility glyphs slate#526173, normal14/24 labels, neutral borders. NO paperplane, simple horizontal arrow or newspaper glyph. Actionbar is explicitly reused supporting-source structure; do not copy main's different post/edit row.
Photo strip below: preserve originalFOUR protected photo crops/order/proportions EXACT: partial narrow dusk sportsfield left, statue topmiddle, skyline/lawn bottommiddle, tall blue-sky park right. Preserve all buildings/statue/trees/people/dog/avatar faces and detailed textures. Keep original partial-carousel edge crops; do not expand photos to fullwidth or normalize columns. Maintain two middle square photos separated by small gap. No photo reconstruction, smoothing, retouching, generated substitute or altered image objects.
Original descriptive dark translucent quote overlays retained, never green button fills. Japanese native leftcaption "芝生の広場", rightcaption "眺めのよい公園". Keep ORIGINAL two tiny reviewer-avatar photos in separate lower right photo topic strip, with Japanese "人々を眺める…" corresponding to visible people-watching text; avatars must not be replaced/redrawn or omitted. No extra scene/photo/title/tabs/device/card or unexplained values.
Only heading bold; all support/action/caption labels Regular, tracking0. Compact readable hierarchy and modest white margins. Static raster candidate only; no claim of actualpark accessibility, hours, owner approval, actions or runtime.
reviewNotes: Original half-star/gold rating, wheelchair and distinct-source diamond directions/bookmark/sharetray/globe glyphs restored with Japanese copy.
